verses.1: In Jehovah do I take refuge: How say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain;
verses.2: For, lo, the wicked bend the bow, They make ready their arrow upon the string, That they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart;
verses.3: If the foundations be destroyed, What can the righteous do?
verses.4: Jehovah is in his holy temple; Jehovah, his throne is in heaven; His eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
verses.5: Jehovah trieth the righteous; But the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
verses.6: Upon the wicked he will rain snares; Fire and brimstone and burning wind shall be the portion of their cup.
verses.7: For Jehovah is righteous; he loveth righteousness: The upright shall behold his face.

metadata.source: Derived from the American Standard Version (1901), revised for the ABIDE Bible App.
